# Camp Afro Foli Drum and Dance Retreat

\\nWanting to know more? [Click here.](/camp-afro-foli-drum-dance-retreat/) \\n \\nCAMP AFRO FOLI DRUM AND DANCE RETREAT PRICING \\n

**Drum Hire:** \\n_There will be drums for hire and sale at the camp._

\\n

**Friend and Family Spectator Only Adult -**  \\nWant to come and enjoy the camp but not ready to drum or dance yet? \\n_Includes accommodation, Friday night dinner, Saturday breakfast, morning tea, lunch, afternoon tea, dinner, African performance, Sunday breakfast, morning tea and lunch._

\\n

**Friend and Family Spectator Only Children 5 -12 years -**  \\nWanting to bring your children to Camp?

\\n

_Includes accommodation, Friday night dinner, Saturday breakfast, morning tea, lunch, afternoon tea, dinner, African performance, Sunday breakfast, morning tea and lunch._

\\n

Please do not bring alcohol into the premise. This is a no alcohol event.

\\n_Terms and Conditions: All Camp Afro Foli Drum and Dance Retreat passes are non-refundable, non-transferable, and cannot be exchanged for classes or services at a later date. Artists may be subject to change due to unforeseen circumstances._
